title: Choir and Smile
author: C. M. Lockridge
blurb: Coral Pemberton, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the well refills.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
